qp.recipe: ferric sigma.rs solve_qp_for_mo on PySCF gw_ac Sigma_c(ef+iw) (textbook Thiele, linearized start, Z clamp [0,1.5], 4-pt FD h=0.05, <=30 Newton steps, |step|<1e-7)
qp.sensitivity_recipe: max |d eps_qp| over 20 random relative perturbations of size 1e-10 of Sigma_c at the Pade nodes

w_static.pi0: 4 sum_ia L_ia L_ia^T / (eps_a - eps_i), HF energies, all occ x all vir

bse_kernel.definition: K = A - diag(eps^QP_a - eps^QP_i) = 2(ia|jb) - (ab|W(0)|ij), singlet, flat ia = i*nvir + a, row-major upper triangle (i <= j) of the nov x nov matrix, as base64 of little-endian float64 bytes

dipole_ia.definition: <i|r|a>, origin 0, [x, y, z][i*nvir + a], PySCF MO phases (the same MOs as bse_kernel)

keywords.pbe_grid: (75, 110) unpruned, Becke partition, Becke-1988 radii adjust

provenance.frozen_core: none unless the block says frozen > 0
provenance.bse: numpy BSE-TDA singlet: A = dQP + 2(ia|jb) - (ab|W(0)|ij), W(0) = L^T (I + Pi(0))^-1 L, Pi(0) on HF energies, full occ x vir, frozen core none, DF with the listed aux (PySCF gw_ac Lpq)
